plan.notes: Official UNL 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Biological Sciences (BS) major page (School of Biological Sciences). Recorded for the Standard Option: 19-hour core + 30 hours ancillary (at catalog minimums) + 18 hours BIOS electives (at least 10 hrs at 300+ level, at least two courses/6 cr at 400 level). Variable-credit requirement blocks (chemistry/physics sequences, quantitative elective, organic chemistry) recorded at catalog minimum per convention. BIOS 99 (Assessment of the Major) is a required 0-credit course. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence, so this is a requirements-only plan. A grade of C or above is required for all courses in the major including ancillary requirements. The full BS degree requires 120 hours including ACE, CAS distribution, and electives.
